summary: In this tutorial, you learn how to create an inert gas using the periodic table tool in the JChemComp environment on Linux version 12.04 and Java version 7.1210. First, open the terminal and navigate to the desktop by typing `cd /home/username/Desktop` and pressing Enter, then type `jchemcomp` and press Enter to open JChemComp. To access the periodic table, click the toolbar button or right-click and select "Periodic Table." You can view details about elements by clicking on them; for example, clicking oxygen shows its properties. To create an element, enter its symbol in the text box and click OK. For instance, entering "Y" creates yttrium. Next, to create an isotope, go to the menu, select "Isotopes," and choose an isotope from the list. Click on an element like yttrium, right-click, and select "Change Element" to change it to another element, such as calcium. This process demonstrates how to manipulate elements and their isotopes within the JChemComp software.
